newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian trade deficit widens Jan-Sept 1996.
newsitem.headline: Austrian trade deficit widens Jan-Sept 1996.

text.p: Austria's trade deficit widened 16.8 billion schillings, or 25.9 percent, to 81.7 billion schillings in the first nine months of 1996, state statistics office OeSTAT said on Tuesday.
In a statement OeSTAT said imports rose 5.6 percent to 525.7 billion schillings while exports increased 2.5 percent to 443.7 billion.

It traced the deterioration in the trade balance to higher imports from Austria's European Union partners. Imports from the EU were up 3.9 percent at 375.1 billion schillings while exports rose 3.4 percent to 294.5 billion.
The EU accounted for 71.4 percent of imports and 66.4 percent of exports, OeSTAT said.
The statistics office said it hoped to release full 1996 trade figures in May. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
